scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the already-started washing and drying of Mateo's aprons before his 19:00 pack-out.
Emerging Need: The paid wash starts, but a building water-supply outage stops all machines and staff return the drained, incompletely washed load.
Decision Context: A saved family errand record distinguishes a nearby same-day restart-and-dry service from a cheaper next-day drop-off, with Mateo's spending and disclosure limits. No matching card or account override can fix the outage.
Consequence: An authorized transfer of the same load can preserve tonight's return; after the 19:00 pack-out, the aprons cannot serve that preparation.

parameter.title: Mateo pantry apron wash run
parameter.description: Wash and dry Mateo's pantry aprons, returning them before his 19:00 pack-out tonight.

parameter.content: The bag with 3 kg of dry aprons is on your porch now. The Tidewater Suds card ending B-04 is clipped inside with the soap sheet. I need the aprons washed, dried and back before my 19:00 pack-out tonight.

parameter.description: Personal cash loaded for ordinary errands this afternoon.

parameter.subject: Washer W18 cycle started
parameter.body: Washer W18 accepted laundry card ending B-04 and started a paid wash cycle at 2:38 PM. Estimated wash completion is 3:16 PM, followed by transfer to dryer row D if the session remains active.

parameter.subject: Wash stopped by building water outage
parameter.body: The building water supply failed at 15:02, stopping all washers including W18. Staff drained and opened W18; the incompletely washed load is ready for collection. Laundry cards remain valid, but no machine here can resume before tomorrow. The desk can provide the interrupted-cycle receipt.

parameter.content: My 19:00 pack-out has finished without the aprons. The load from the interrupted wash was not washed and dried in time for tonight. Returning it tomorrow can only help with a later shift.
